title: Roles Registry File (roles.json)
description: Schema for the roles registry. Roles are stackable trait bundles assigned to NPCs. Per ADR-0012. Registry File pattern per ADR-0004. The roles.json file at project root maps role ids to role definitions.

Role.description: A single stackable trait bundle. Multiple roles stack on an NPC; their fields combine according to engine rules.

description.description: Designer notes. Not consumed by the LLM.

status_in_sub_faction.description: How this role positions an NPC in the sub_faction's Turchin stratification. Affects E count contribution, succession eligibility, conflict dynamics.

default_disposition_baseline.description: Affinity modifier toward the player at instantiation. Negative means starts hostile; positive means starts friendly; 0 is neutral.

allowed_actions.description: Tool call labels this role unlocks in the NPC's allowlist. Combined across all roles on the NPC.

drive_biases.description: Drives this role tends to instill. Used by procgen NPC template instantiation; an NPC with this role gets these drives biased toward higher weight.

incompatible_with.description: Role URNs that cannot stack with this one. Validator and procgen system enforce.

requires_sub_faction_stratum.description: If present, this role requires the sub_faction to have a matching status_in_sub_faction stratum (e.g., role:slave_overseer requires the sub_faction to have a slave economy).
